body:
Adds the owner-approved optional patient emergency contact: supplying any value requires name, relationship and phone. Existing patient view/update permissions govern access; registration can stage the change and commit it atomically with the visit. Contacts remain patient-level, separate from guardian/family/HR data, and never enter board/TV/public/search payloads.

Includes the approved two-table migration, encrypted values, versioned removal tombstones, actor/patient/context-bound idempotent commands and new tests. No new permission or existing assertion change. Feature-only extraction excludes Registration restyle #1132 and TRI2 alerts.

The static recovery refreshes main e5e72f69b normally and fixes only braces/formatting in the new frontend test. Eight local ESLint errors reproduced the failed static step; independent review confirms unchanged cases, fixtures and assertions. Domain/migration parity remains exact.

Fresh local validation: focused backend 13 tests/49 assertions, actual contention 2 tests/14 assertions, feature frontend 4/4, full repository lint/format, frontend types/build, Pint and PHPStan all pass. Full frontend suite: 2,207/2,207 passed with no skips. Earlier backend CI shards 1–3 passed; updated-head remote CI remains required. Prior synthetic UI review is carried evidence, not a new browser run for this test-only formatting change.

Draft PR; no production migration or merge requested. Optional-contact rules and exact schema approvals are recorded in the design note. No new business scope is introduced by the recovery.
